message: 痛くしないで……
With just a little over a month left until the Holy Night Festival, I wonder what we can do to make it sparkle?
As I walk down the usual hallway, I vaguely picture Christmas illuminations in my head.

name: Synn
message: 「That's it! We just need to decorate the usual scenery」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's got into ya all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll explain right now. Rather than the hallway... yeah, let's head to the entrance. It's got an open atrium, so it'll look great」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's put a huge tree right in the middle of the entrance hall!」

name: Synn
message: 「And wouldn't it be wonderful if we strung twinkling lights along the stairs, handrails, and windows too?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not a bad idea, but is the Holy Night Festival mainly indoors or outdoors?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Outdoors...」

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chi, here I go~!」

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Sally, please refrain from doing anything reckless!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! Five-step jump, boing~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, that's dangerous!」
Before I knew it, Sally-chan was using the stairs as a playground, and Shio-chan was trying to stop her.

name: Sally
message: 「Huge success\s07」

name: Shio
message: 「You must not play inside the school building!」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft. You don't have to be such a sore loser just because you can't do it, Shio-chi~」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-Wh-What did you say!? Even I am capable of such a feat...」
Ah, I've got a bad feeling about this.

name: Shio
message: 「Witness my stair-skipping technique, honed on the front approach of Asukai! Behold!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She was tryin' to stop her, and now she's startin' a contest. Just what you'd expect from Hisu's little sis」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph. Six-step jump, complete. That is roughly what I am capable of」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph! Then I'm gonna go for a seven-step jump!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yaho~~♪」

name: Shio
message: 「How cheeky! In that case, I shall perform an eight-step jump!」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's with this turn of events?」

name: Synn
message: 「Cut it out, you two!」

name: Shio
message: 「Having suffered a crushing defeat on the test, I cannot afford to lose to Lady Sally as well」

name: Synn
message: 「No, those aren't even things you compare!」

name: Shio
message: 「No arguments! Hyaaa!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Lord Synn? Why do you avert your gaze? Please behold my gallant leap」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall land just like this and claim a splendid victory--」

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chi, your panties are showing?」

name: Shio
message: 「Whaaaaat did you say?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-wh-what?! M-My balance is--」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh... mgggggggggggh~~!」

name: Sally
message: 「A-wah-wah-wah, Shio-chi's foot is all swollen and turning pink...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, when horseplay goes too far, this is pretty much how things always wrap up」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, I'll carry you to the infirmary. Do you want a piggyback ride or a princess carry?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ngggggh... 'Tis merely a scratch...!」

name: Sally
message: 「Shio-chi. Are you okay...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hup」

name: Synn
message: 「Riesling-san?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「And he just jumped down nineteen steps in a single bound, too?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the rough-and-ready treatment of my lady's schoolmates to this humble butler, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, what brings you here today?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am on my way back after finishing an errand for Helena」

name: Shio
message: 「I hate things that hurt! Sir Butler, please be gentle!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Shio...」

name: Shio
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Riesling
message: 「In the humble opinion of this Riesling Tooyama, since Lady Sally possesses wings with which to glide, would an equal match not be impossible to establish?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ah!? Y-You're right--」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hmph.」

name: Shio
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing! The swelling is going down right before our eyes!」

name: Riesling
message: 「You are too kind.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then.」
Riesling-san leaps up nineteen steps at once back to the second floor and disappears somewhere.

name: Sally
message: 「Hnngh, hnngh... Shio-chi is so heavy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, she did pass out cold...」

name: Sally
message: 「I can't carry her all by myself~! Prez, Paqy, help me out~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, can't be helped... Honestly!」

name: Synn
message: 「For all your complaining, you always end up lending a hand, don't you, Paqy?」
With great difficulty, we carried Shio-chan all the way to Asukai Shrine.
And then, we realized a crucial fact.
Since Shio-chan's leg was already healed, we didn't need to bring her all the way out here--we could have just let her rest in the academy infirmary.
